evidence: script-installed-with-the-list: manifest 29-34 declares the file mode 0755 owner/group $file_owner (fixture root) from set_vpn_passwd.sh.erb; template line 16 renders each vpn_list element with a leading space, so [VPN1, VPN2] gives VPN_LIST=" VPN1 VPN2"; probe stat + grep and expect 'root:root 755' match exactly

vpn-profiles-and-a-dialog-stub: template 15-20 looks for /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/<name>; the setup writes VPN1 (listed) and VPN3 (unlisted) keyfiles at that path and a logging kdialog stub, and the effect reads NetworkManager's loaded connections and the stub, not the action's output; mutates declares all of it. Note: its 'as openvpn_nm_connection writes them' is approximate (baseline connection_file.erb writes password-flags=1 and permissions=user:...; the set uses password-flags=0, a deviation the file header declares)

matching-answers-set-the-listed-connection: template 18-23 runs nmcli connection modify <name> vpn.secrets password=<pw> only for listed names whose keyfile exists; with VPN1 listed+present, VPN2 listed+absent, VPN3 unlisted, the expected VPN1 secret p8test-pass-a, empty VPN3, 2 password prompts (lines 30, 37) and the final 'Configuration finished.' msgbox (line 59) are what the code produces

finding a-second-run-changes-the-password: expected VPN1 secret p8test-pass-c after a second run, saw 'rc=0 / VPN1: [password = p8test-pass-a]' (unchanged). Reproduced and confirmed on the node after the run via lab_exec: /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections holds only VPN3; nmcli shows VPN1 and VPN2 backed by /run/NetworkManager/system-connections/netplan-NM-<uuid>.nmconnection with /etc/netplan/90-NM-*.yaml (NetworkManager 1.46.0), so line 20's [ -f /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/VPN1 ] is false and the second run skips VPN1 silently while still reporting 'Configuration finished'

purpose gap: Tested: install with owner/mode and the rendered list; a matching pair sets the listed present connection and leaves listed-absent and unlisted ones alone; cancel at the first dialog shows the cancel message and exits; a mismatch shows the message and re-asks, then a match sets the password; a second run (finding: it no longer finds the profile). Gap 1: the stated purpose says 'blank or mismatched answers are asked again', but no outcome row or check exercises the blank branch (template 44-45, BLANK_PASSWD msgbox then re-ask); the lab can exercise it with the same stub (an empty answer with exit 0), so it must be tested. Gap 2: profiles are written with password-flags=0 and no permissions=user:..., while openvpn_nm_connection (connection_file.erb) writes password-flags=1 (agent-owned secret) plus user permissions; how the script behaves on the profile production actually has (secret going to the desktop user's secret agent) is neither tested nor listed under uncovered with evidence and lifted_by. Minor: cancelling-changes-nothing only reads VPN3, an unlisted connection the script never touches, so it shows the exit path (last call is the cancel msgbox) but not that a listed connection kept its password; cancel at the second dialog (lines 39-42) is untested.
